sections.water: Irrigation demand is 79,380 m3. The plan supplies 79380.00 m3 from your quota; any shortfall lowers yield.
sections.soil: Soil nitrogen moves from 98.60 to 79.70 kg/ha across the rotation. The soil score of -0.19 rewards nitrogen gain and penalises nitrogen below the critical level.
sections.rotation_risk: Two exhaustive crops sit next to each other in: seq-012, seq-027, seq-042, seq-055, seq-056, seq-057. That draws down soil nitrogen faster.
sections.caveat: Crop prices, input costs and nitrogen values are placeholders, not agronomic advice. Ask an expert before planting.
